instruction.name: vfnmadd.s
instruction.description: Compute packed single precision floating point FMA(Fused Multiply-Add): multiply elements in `a` and `b`, accumulate to elements in `c` and store the negated result in `dst`.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr3, $r4
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr3, $r4' --asm 'vfnmadd.s $vr0, $vr0, $vr2, $vr3'

notes: LBT-free LASX/LSX fused multiply-add. vd is write-only: it is not read as an accumulator (a vd -> vd chain runs at about 0.5 cycles). The vj, vk, and va paths each cost 5 cycles.
